candidates.title: Don't Stop Me Now: Embedding Based Scheduling for LLMs
candidates.reason: Focused LLM serving scheduler that uses request embeddings to improve size/remaining-time estimates for preemptive scheduling and reduce completion time.

candidates.title: KVLink: Accelerating Large Language Models via Efficient KV Cache Reuse
candidates.reason: Focused KV-cache reuse method for composing independently precomputed caches, directly reducing repeated prefill work in long-context/RAG inference.

candidates.title: Scalable and Efficient MoE Training for Multitask Multilingual Models
candidates.reason: Strong MoE training-systems work combining multidimensional parallelism and heterogeneous memory, implemented in DeepSpeed and demonstrated at trillion-parameter scale.

candidates.title: Prompt Cache: Modular Attention Reuse for Low-Latency Inference
candidates.reason: Serving-oriented prompt/KV state reuse system that precomputes reusable attention states for shared prompt modules and substantially reduces TTFT.

candidates.title: Aegaeon: Effective GPU Pooling for Concurrent LLM Serving on the Market
candidates.reason: SOSP 2025 serving-systems work on effective GPU pooling for concurrent multi-model LLM serving, directly relevant to utilization and model multiplexing.
